notes.title: v0.80 Notes
notes.notes:
🃏 Card purchase glitch resolved – No more awkward hovering!

🗑️ New Trashbag added, replacing the old trashcan.

🎁 Box content visual improved – Figure count now clearer and more accurate.

🧱 ShelfLarge material updated for a more polished display.

📦 Box placement issue fixed – No more boxes sinking into the ground.

📊 Daily Report updates – Now smoother and more reliable.

✋ ShelfRow hand animations improved for added realism.

💳 Credit card interactions now smoother – includes new swipe animation into the machine!

🧠 Level synchronization improved across systems.

🛒 Customer interactions upgraded:

If an item isn't available in the shop, customers will now say exactly what they're looking for.

Product selection is now limited to items that are unlocked based on player level.

Speech bubbles have been added when customers can’t find specific products.

Figure-related bugs have been squashed.

All reported bugs have been addressed in this patch.

notes.title: Version 0.0.76 – “We Hear You!” Update is Live
notes.notes:
🎉 Version 0.0.76 – “We Hear You!” Update is Live 🛠️

📝 Steam Reviews & Feedback Matter! Your reviews and feedback are incredibly important to us. If you're enjoying the game—or even if you've got ideas to make it better—please don't forget to leave a review on Steam. It truly helps! 💬❤️

🐞 F12 Bug Reports Help a Ton! In-game reports via the F12 key have been super helpful—thank you! If you'd like a reply, don’t forget to include your email so we can follow up directly. 💌


Hey Card Shopkeepers! Your feedback’s been loud and clear—and this update reflects many of your top requests along with important fixes. Thanks for helping shape our cozy, chaotic card-selling world!

🆕 Patch Highlights:

🔁 Days no longer end automatically. You’ll now need to end the day manually when you’re ready.

🕘 After 9 PM, no more customers will arrive—time to clean up and reorganize!

🔒 In-game lobby types (Public, Private, etc.) can now be changed mid-session.

✨ The card reveal screen has been polished for a smoother animation and visual clarity.

🎴 Fixed the bug where booster packs couldn’t be opened properly.

💾 Vending Machine boxes now save correctly across sessions.

🛒 Resolved Steam Inventory integration bugs—item syncing should now be stable.

🕛 Game start on Day 12. Fixed

🏆 Steam Achievements have been activated! Time to start collecting.

🛍️ Shop products now appear sorted by unlock level, so you can find what’s new faster.

💻 Improved performance for Intel GPUs—the game now runs more smoothly on Medium, Low, and Very Low settings.

🪔 Fixed incorrect naming on Lamp items.

🎲 Updated names for Dice products.

📏 Warehouse shelf scaling issues have been resolved.

 Known issue:  Intel GPUs has problem High and Ultra resolutions.

Thanks again for being part of this growing community. Keep those bug clips and feature ideas coming!

Now get back in there and make your card shop legendary. – The Dev Team

notes.title: We Have a Big Problem 🚨🚨🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Collectors,[/b]
Playtest was supposed to be this week.
But no matter what we did, we couldn’t convince our NPCs (or our codebase) to put on pants.
They just kept strolling into the shop naked and proud.
So we gave up and added a “No Naked Entry 🚫” sign. Problem solved? We'll see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/10d20d68320c1cbc0726c351cfa969d5acde175a.png[/img]

Okay, now the serious part (kinda).

Unlike many multiplayer games out there, we wanted to support hotjoin — so your friends can hop into your game while you’re already playing.
That means no more “wait let’s restart” or “bruh, too late.”
More fun, more chaos, more trading — anytime.

But… supporting hotjoin meant a LOT of extra work:

Syncing NPCs, players, items, weather, cat moods, and the price of gum.

Making sure new players don’t break everything when they enter mid-game.

Basically, rewriting half the game just to make joining look like it was always that smooth.

So yes, we delayed the playtest.
But we’re doing it for you. And for our dignity. And for clothes.

And hey... we actually have some really cool plans to give you a true collector experience—
wait, I wasn’t supposed to say that.
Sorry team. Please don’t revoke my card sleeves. 😳

Thanks for being patient — playtest is close (and everyone’s wearing pants this time).
💛

— Alkame Games 🎮

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Playtest Around the Corner!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Collectors,[/b]

First off, apologies for the delay in the playtest. But rest assured, we’re getting so close now! We’re ironing out the final details on the multiplayer front, and very soon, you’ll be able to apply for access to the playtest on Steam. Since we don’t have the option to manually select participants, if you’re eager to play with your friends, we’re considering offering instant access keys for 1$ via Buy Me a Coffee
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/5bee1a71cc0c23c35aef894c4b16df32e0fa407a.gif[/img]

[h1]What Have We Been Up To?[/h1]

[h2][b]Card Designs[/b] [/h2]
We’ve been diving deep into crafting card designs. Our plan is to have 10 rarity levels in the game: Frequent, Common, Uncommon, Scarce, Rare, UltraRare, Exotic, Mythical, Epic, and Legendary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/43458586ff350e0d7b902853f63f7ffebd71e294.gif[/img]




[b]Collection [/b]
You’ll be able to collect individual cards, sell them, or trade them with others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/bec3062a2dfeea7aff6dd4c75f843784eaf893e4.gif[/img]




[h2][b]Trades[/b][/h2]
The game will feature both single-card sales and trade options with customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/174c43eb0857de2d5b962e194534be8ee45c5146.gif[/img]




[h2][b]Shop and Furnitures[/b][/h2]
Our in-game furniture and product shop are ready! Plus, we’ve completed designing a variety of furniture and items. You’ll be able to place products on shelves and set their prices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/61322f8c64e960ee0a0f68f84d51ff601864d9c2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/04b4aa46ec229e488fe43f5e24cc086f8860d582.gif[/img]



[h2]Shop and City View[/h2]
Our game world and shop are good to go. Of course, you’ll start in a smaller shop, but with progress, you can grow it into something extraordinary.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/84a363fd88c910203c1072032d3a8c57d9d4af4b.gif[/img]



[h2]Where Were We in Devlog #1?[/h2]

Looking back, we think we’ve made solid progress—and in a fun way, too! From tackling multiplayer chaos to designing placeholder cubes, it’s been a journey full of challenges and laughs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310793/91ab71e02576879c12fc552d4f09868c28716c28.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #1 Building Something Special (With Your Help!)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Collectors![/b]

First off, thank you for all the messages asking, “How’s the game going?!” It means the world to our small team that you’re this excited about TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator. Time for a update you.

[b]Why We’re Skipping the Next Fest[/b]
We’ve decided to sit out the upcoming game fest. Why? We’re not here to rush. We’d rather spend these months making sure the game feels right instead of racing to meet a deadline. This means more time to listen to your feedback, tweak mechanics, and polish the chaos of running a card shop with friends.


[h1]The Road Ahead: Phases, Friends, & Fun[/h1]
Here’s the plan to get this party started:

Closed Alpha Test (Late February 2025): For our most hardcore early supporters. Help us break things!

Closed Beta,Open Beta

Demo : Everyone’s invited to join us at June Next Fest!

[b]Early Access Launch (June 2025)[/b]: The shop’s (almost) open! We’ll keep refining based on your feedback.

Yes, it’s a lot of phases—but multiplayer games need love (and testing). A rushed launch would mean a messy shop, and nobody wants that.

Current Progress: The Good, The Ugly, and The Placeholder Cubes
Done ✅:

Multiplayer core: Player spawning, sync, resource management.

Shop management: Orders, loans, and the panic-inducing “management computer.”

[b]Next Up [/b]🛠️:

New gameplay modules (NPCs,Ordering etc).

[b]Visuals [/b]🎨: Our 3D models (shops, characters, cards) are ready to go—they’re just waiting to be plugged into the game! Devs are working on bringing them to life, so stay tuned for sneak peeks in Devlog #2.

[b]Modding Support [/b]🔧: We’re not putting up walls! Since this isn’t competitive, we’re keeping the doors wide open for mods—custom cards, shop designs, rule tweaks, you name it. We won’t lock things down, so modders can tinker freely (just like your favorite games!). Share your creations with the community!

[b]Why Multiplayer = “Wait, Why Is My Friend Floating?!”[/b]
Let’s be honest: multiplayer games are hard. Testing takes much more longer because every bug has to be squashed across different connections and “Wait, did YOU just crash the economy?!” moments. But we’re committed to making the shop-running chaos feel smooth, fun, and reliably chaotic.

[h1]We Need YOU![/h1]
Join Our Discord: This is where we’ll share beta sign-ups, scream about breakthroughs, and beg for your ideas. You can find discord link down below.

[b]Spread the Word:[/b] The more testers, the merrier (and the fewer disasters at launch).

Tell Us Everything: What’s your dream feature for a card shop sim? NPC baristas? A black market for rare cards? We’re listening.

Thanks for being part of this journey. We’re a tiny team, but your excitement keeps our coffee mugs full and our keyboards clacking. Next time, we’ll have fewer programmer-art cubes and more actual art. Promise.

Until then, keep those decks shuffled!

— Alkame Games. 🎮

[b]P.S[/b]. If you see a floating cube in our screenshots… no you didn’t.
